purpose: Portable archival record of newly generated synthetic calibration evidence; not the original byte-identical report or a factory admission artifact

transformation.method: Recursively replace project/runtime workspace path prefixes only in string values; preserve all keys, numeric values, arrays, non-path identity values, measurements and authority flags; path-bearing identity/probe values are deliberately transformed
transformation.projectPrefix: project:// refers to a path relative to the project source root
transformation.runtimePrefix: candidate-runtime:// refers to a path relative to the separately built candidate runtime root

retentionLimits: Does not restore raw machine-absolute report bytes, binary tools, media outputs or streamed PCM bytes
Original report hash is provenance, not the hash of this transformed object
Independent saved-output audit did not rerun decoding or establish general pixel quality
Any future service qualification must deliberately review this record and its producer/runtime scope, not substitute this for an old pinned receipt

report.boundsClassification: preregistered-clock-derived-acceptance-bounds; measured only by this campaign, never automatic catalog authority

derivation.video: source video tick + fixed output tick + one microsecond representation allowance
derivation.audioInterior: source audio tick + one source sample + fixed output tick
derivation.audioEndpoint: audio interior quantization only; FLAC adds no coding tail
derivation.containerDuration: end-timestamp: max decoded video/audio output end; duration bound = video bound + ceil(one sample)
derivation.sampleCount: zero: complete selected canonical s16le PCM byte/hash/sample identity
